_readme: Search pages for each widget: favcircles.com/widgets/<slug>.html, built by website/tools/build-widgets-page.js with widgets.json. Never rename a slug (it's the page's address). title <= 60 chars, description <= 155. Plain words, nothing that isn't in the app.

events.title: Party Planner & RSVP App for iPhone with Shared Album
events.description: Plan a party, trip or night out on iPhone: invite anyone by email, track RSVPs and head counts, and share one photo album with your guests.
events.h1: Plan the party, track the RSVPs, share one album
events.intro: Events in FavCircles is an RSVP and party planner for iPhone. Set the date and place, invite friends by link or email (they don't need the app to answer), see who's coming with head counts, and keep every photo and video from the night in one album only your guests can see.
faq: Do my guests need the app to RSVP?
No. Invite anyone by email and they tap Going, Maybe or Can't go from the invite, with how many adults and kids are coming.
Can everyone add photos to the album?
Yes. Everyone who joined the event can add photos and videos, and download the whole night to their Photos in one tap.

clubs.title: Run Club & Book Club App for iPhone: Meetups and RSVPs
clubs.description: Organize a run club, walking group or book club on iPhone: weekly meetups, who's going, reminders, announcements and a message board.
clubs.h1: Run your club from one link
clubs.intro: Clubs in FavCircles is an app for run clubs, walk groups, book clubs and any group that meets. Share one link to bring people in, set weekly meetups like "Saturdays 7 AM at the park", see who's going, and keep everyone posted with announcements and a message board.
faq: What kinds of clubs can I start?
Run, walk, ride, hike, swim, yoga, books or anything else that meets.
Do members get reminders?
Yes. Members who tap Going get a reminder an hour before each meetup, and organizers' announcements arrive as notifications.

dogs.title: Dog App for iPhone: Vaccine Reminders and a Dog Park
dogs.description: Keep your dog's vaccines, vet visits and paperwork in one place with due-date reminders, and share photos in a community of dog people.
dogs.h1: Your dog's records, reminders and a park full of good dogs
dogs.intro: Can I Pet Dat Dog is a dog app inside FavCircles. Give each dog a profile, keep vaccine records with due-date reminders, vet visits, medications, weight and vet paperwork in one private place, and post photos and short videos to the Dog Park.
faq: Can I get reminders when my dog's vaccines are due?
Yes. Add each vaccine with its due date and you'll get a reminder.
Who can see my dog's health records?
Only you. Health and insurance details stay private; the Dog Park only shows what you post there.

howareyou.title: Check On Elderly Parents: Daily Check-In App for iPhone
howareyou.description: Daily check-ins for Mom or Dad: questions at the times you pick, one-tap answers from the Lock Screen, and a heads-up when something needs attention.
howareyou.h1: Check on Mom or Dad, a few taps a day
howareyou.intro: How Are You? is a daily check-in app for an aging parent. Pick the questions and the times, and your parent answers with one tap from the Lock Screen. You get a heads-up when an answer needs attention or when they go quiet, and brothers and sisters can share the same check-in.
faq: What kinds of questions can I ask?
Questions that fit their life: pain from 0 to 10, whether they took their meds, how they slept, PT days and rides.
Can my siblings see the answers too?
Yes. Brothers and sisters can join the same check-in, and anyone can tap "I'll call" so the family knows it's handled.

postcard.title: Send a Real Postcard from Your Photo on iPhone
postcard.description: Turn a trip photo into a postcard: pick a design, add a note, and send it to a chat or email, or have it printed and mailed anywhere in the US.
postcard.h1: Turn your trip photo into a real postcard
postcard.intro: Postcard in FavCircles turns a photo into a postcard. Pick a photo and a design, write a note, and send it to a friend's chat, by email or as a link. Or have it printed and mailed to any US address, with delivery updates along the way.
faq: Can it be mailed as a real printed postcard?
Yes. Have it printed and mailed anywhere in the US, and follow its delivery.
Does the person I send it to need the app?
No. A shared postcard opens as a link anyone can view.

fridgemail.title: Mail Kids' Drawings to Grandparents Every Week
fridgemail.description: Snap your child's drawing and we print it and mail it to Grandma. Send to up to three grandparents on a weekly schedule and track every card.
fridgemail.h1: Kids' drawings, in Grandma's mailbox every week
fridgemail.intro: Fridge Mail turns your kids' artwork into real mail. Snap a photo of the drawing and we print it and mail it to up to three grandparents on a weekly schedule. Follow every card from the printer to the mailbox.
faq: How many grandparents can I send to?
Up to three, on a weekly schedule.
Can I see what was sent?
Yes. Follow every card from the printer to the mailbox, and tap one to see it full size.

billsplit.title: Bill Split & Tip Calculator for iPhone
billsplit.description: Split the check and the tip in seconds: enter the bill, pick the tip, tip on the pre-tax amount if you like, and share the split in the group chat.
billsplit.h1: Split the check and the tip in seconds
billsplit.intro: Bill Split is a tip calculator and check splitter. Enter the bill, pick the tip and see what everyone owes. Tip on the pre-tax amount, round up if you like, and drop the split into the group chat as a card.
faq: Can I tip on the amount before tax?
Yes. Choose to tip on the pre-tax amount.
Can I send the split to my friends?
Yes. Share it as a card in the group chat.

nextbar.title: Find a Bar Near You, Picked from Where Friends Go
nextbar.description: Can't pick the next bar? NextBar picks one near you from your saved places and your friends', or starts a group vote on where to go next.
nextbar.h1: Your next bar, picked from where your friends go
nextbar.intro: NextBar picks a bar near you from the places you and your friends have saved in FavCircles, so it's somewhere people you know actually like. Or start a group vote and let everyone pick where to go next.
faq: Where do the picks come from?
From bars near you that you and your friends have saved in FavCircles.
Can my group vote?
Yes. Start a group vote and everyone picks where to go next.

whattoeat.title: What Should I Eat? A One-Tap Food Decider for iPhone
whattoeat.description: Can't decide what to eat? Spin for a craving and see where to get it nearby, starting with places you and your friends saved.
whattoeat.h1: Can't decide what to eat? Spin for it
whattoeat.intro: What to Eat is a one-tap food decider. Spin for a craving and see where to get it near you, starting with the places you and your friends saved. Narrow it to comfort food, spicy, healthy, veggie, cheap eats or treat yourself, and spin again if you're not feeling it.
faq: Does it show places near me?
Yes. It shows where to get your craving nearby, with places you and your friends saved first.
Can I narrow it down?
Yes: comfort, spicy, healthy, veggie, cheap eats or treat yourself.

drink.title: Cocktail Recipes App: Classics, Calories, Surprise Me
drink.description: Cocktail recipes for every spirit with calories on every drink, a surprise-me shake for something new, and a way to send a recipe to a friend.
drink.h1: A cocktail for tonight, and how to make any classic
drink.intro: Make Me a Drink has cocktail recipes for every spirit, with the calories on every drink. Tap surprise me for a random pick, find something to order tonight, and send a recipe to a friend's chat.
faq: Does it show calories?
Yes, every drink shows its calories.
Can it suggest a drink for me?
Yes. Use the surprise-me shake for a random pick.

workouts.title: Workout Log App for iPhone: Sets, Reps, PRs, Routines
workouts.description: Log sets, reps and personal records with 16 ready-made routines, form tips for every exercise, a rest timer, and routines that remember last time.
workouts.h1: Log sets, reps and personal records
workouts.intro: Workouts in FavCircles is a gym log for iPhone. Start from one of 16 ready-made routines (5×5, push/pull/legs, full body, dumbbells only, no-equipment home and core) or build your own. Routines remember last time's numbers, every exercise has form tips, and cardio counts calories.
faq: Are there workouts I can do at home?
Yes. There are no-equipment home and core routines, plus dumbbell-only ones.
Does it track personal records?
Yes. Your personal records are tracked, and routines remember last time's numbers.

run.title: GPS Run Tracker for iPhone: Route Map, Pace, Splits
run.description: Track your runs with a GPS route map, pace, splits and personal bests, with your run live on the Lock Screen and sharing with the friends you choose.
run.h1: Track your runs on a map
run.intro: FavRun is a GPS run tracker. See your route on a map with pace, splits and personal bests, follow your run on the Lock Screen as you go, and share it with the friends you choose.
faq: Does it show my run on the Lock Screen?
Yes. Your run stays on the Lock Screen while you go.
Who can see my runs?
Only the friends you choose to share with.

motivation.title: Workout Motivation App: A Tough-Love Coach for iPhone
motivation.description: Coach Mane is an animated coach with a fresh tough-love line every time, reminders through the day and a streak that keeps you from skipping.
motivation.h1: A coach who won't let you skip
motivation.intro: Coach Mane is a motivation coach in FavCircles. He has a fresh line every time (tough love, or savage if you dare), reminds you through the day, and keeps a streak when you tap Did it. Send his line to a friend who needs to hear it.
faq: Will it remind me?
Yes. Coach Mane reminds you through the day, and tapping Did it keeps your streak.
How harsh is he?
Pick tough love, or savage if you dare.

water.title: Water Reminder & Drink Tracker for iPhone
water.description: Track how much water you drink with one tap per glass, a daily goal and streaks, plus reminders every 1 to 4 hours you can log right from.
water.h1: A water reminder that's one tap per glass
water.intro: Water in FavCircles is a simple water tracker. Tap once per glass toward a daily goal, keep a streak, and see the month at a glance. Turn on reminders every 1 to 4 hours and log a cup right from the notification.
faq: Can it remind me to drink water?
Yes, every 1 to 4 hours, your choice.
Can I log water without opening the app?
Yes. Log a cup right from the reminder notification.

habits.title: Habit Tracker for iPhone with Daily Check-Ins & Streaks
habits.description: Build habits with one-tap daily check-ins, every day or only the days you choose, and keep your streak and your best streak.
habits.h1: Daily check-ins and streaks for the habits you want
habits.intro: Habits in FavCircles is a habit tracker with one-tap check-ins. Track a habit every day or only on the days you choose, watch your streak and your best streak, and retire a habit without losing its history.
faq: Can a habit be just some days of the week?
Yes. Every day, or only the days you choose.
What happens to old habits?
Retired habits keep their history.

calories.title: Simple Calorie Counter & Macro Tracker for iPhone
calories.description: Log meals in a couple of taps toward a daily calorie goal, add macro goals if you want them, and see your last 7 days at a glance.
calories.h1: Count calories in a couple of taps
calories.intro: Calories in FavCircles is a quick calorie counter. Log what you eat in a couple of taps toward a daily goal, add macro goals if you want them, keep recent foods one tap away, and see your last 7 days at a glance.
faq: Does it track macros?
Yes, if you set macro goals.
Is logging quick?
Yes. Recent foods are one tap away.

heartbeat.title: Heart Rate Monitor with Your iPhone Camera
heartbeat.description: Measure your heart rate with your iPhone camera, or connect a Bluetooth heart-rate strap, and get a reading in under 20 seconds.
heartbeat.h1: Check your pulse with your phone's camera
heartbeat.intro: Heartbeat in FavCircles measures your heart rate with your iPhone's camera: rest a fingertip on the lens and a guide shows when it's steady. Or connect a Bluetooth heart-rate strap. You get a reading in under 20 seconds.
faq: How does the camera measure my pulse?
Rest your fingertip over the camera lens; a guide shows when your finger is steady, and you get a reading in under 20 seconds.
Can I use a chest strap?
Yes. Connect a Bluetooth heart-rate strap.
goodToKnow: For everyday wellness, not medical use.

meds.title: Medication Reminder & Pill Tracker for iPhone
meds.description: A reminder for every dose with one tap to log it from the notification, missed doses flagged, and your last 7 days and month at a glance.
meds.h1: A reminder for every dose, and one tap to log it
meds.intro: Medications in FavCircles is a pill reminder and tracker. Add each medication with its dose and times, get a reminder at each one, and tap Took it right from the notification (or snooze 10 minutes). Missed doses are flagged, and it's private to you.
faq: Can I log a dose from the reminder?
Yes. Tap Took it right from the notification, or snooze it 10 minutes.
Who can see my medications?
Only you.

sleep.title: Sleep Score from Apple Health, Every Morning
sleep.description: A nightly sleep score out of 100 from Apple Health: how long you slept, time asleep in bed, consistency and sleep stages, with 7-night averages.
sleep.h1: How well you slept, scored every morning
sleep.intro: Sleep Score reads your sleep from Apple Health (from your Apple Watch or any sleep app) and scores each night out of 100, from how long you slept, your time asleep in bed, consistency and sleep stages. No watch? Log a night by hand.
faq: Do I need an Apple Watch?
No. It reads any sleep app that saves to Apple Health, or you can log a night by hand.
Where is my sleep data kept?
Your Health data stays on your phone.

wakeup.title: Pandora & Spotify Alarm Clock for iPhone
wakeup.description: Wake up to your Pandora, Spotify or Apple Music station: a real iPhone alarm that rings even on silent, then opens your station when you stop it.
wakeup.h1: An alarm that wakes you up to your music station
wakeup.intro: Wake Up is an alarm clock that wakes you up to your Pandora, Spotify or Apple Music station. It sets real alarms that ring like the Clock app's, even on silent or in a Focus. When you stop the alarm, your station opens. Snooze rings again after 5 to 20 minutes, set per alarm.
faq: Can I use a Pandora station as my alarm?
Yes. Copy the station's share link in Pandora, paste it into the alarm, and your station opens when you stop the alarm.
Does it work with Spotify or Apple Music?
Yes. Paste a link from Spotify, Apple Music or any music app.
Does it ring on silent?
Yes. Alarms ring like the Clock app's, even on silent or in a Focus.
goodToKnow: The alarm rings with an alarm sound, and your station starts when you stop it.

weather.title: Weather with Rain Radar and a 10-Day Forecast
weather.description: The weather where you are, hour by hour and 10 days out, with live rain radar around US places and the cities you care about a swipe away.
weather.h1: Right now, the next hours and 10 days
weather.intro: Weather in FavCircles shows the weather where you are, hour by hour and 10 days out. Save the cities you care about and swipe between them, watch live rain radar around US places, and see the temperature on the app's home screen.
faq: Is there a rain radar?
Yes, live rain radar around US places.
Can I follow other cities?
Yes. Save the cities you care about and swipe between them.

stocks.title: Stock Watchlist for iPhone: Indexes, Rates, Bitcoin
stocks.description: The Nasdaq, Dow and S&P at a glance, your own named watchlists with daily charts, and the 10-year yield and Bitcoin right on the card.
stocks.h1: Indexes, rates, crypto and the stocks you follow
stocks.intro: Stocks in FavCircles puts the Nasdaq, Dow and S&P at a glance next to your own watchlist. Keep named lists you can reorder with a chart for each day, and see the 10-year yield and Bitcoin right on the card.
faq: Can I make more than one watchlist?
Yes. Keep named lists and reorder them.
Does it show crypto?
Yes, Bitcoin is right on the card.

quotes.title: Daily Quote Notifications on Your Topics
quotes.description: Inspiring quotes at the times you pick, on the topics you choose, as often as you like, and share any quote with a friend.
quotes.h1: Good lines, at the times you pick
quotes.intro: Quotes in FavCircles sends you good lines at the times you pick. Choose your topics and how many times a day, and share a quote with a friend when one lands.
faq: Can I choose the topics?
Yes, pick your topics and how many times a day.
Can I share a quote?
Yes, send any quote to a friend.

sleepsounds.title: Sleep Sounds & White Noise for iPhone, Works Offline
sleepsounds.description: Real rain, thunder, ocean, campfire and fan recordings plus white, pink and brown noise. Mix your own blend, set a fade-out timer, and play offline.
sleepsounds.h1: Rain, ocean, fire: mix and drift off
sleepsounds.intro: Sleep Sounds has real recordings of rain, thunder, ocean waves, a stream, wind, crickets, a campfire and a heartbeat, plus white, pink and brown noise and a fan. Mix your own blend, set a timer that fades out gently, and get a bedtime reminder with a Play button. The sounds are in the app, so it works offline.
faq: Does it have white noise?
Yes: white, pink and brown noise, plus a fan.
Does it work without internet?
Yes. The sounds are in the app.

parking.title: Remember Where You Parked: Car Finder & Meter Timer
parking.description: Save your parking spot in one tap with a photo and note, get walking directions back to your car, and a reminder before the meter runs out.
parking.intro: Parking in FavCircles saves your spot in one tap, with an optional photo and note (level, row, landmark). Get walking directions back to your car, and a meter reminder before time runs out and again when it expires.
faq: Will it remind me about the parking meter?
Yes, before time runs out and again when it expires.
Is my parking photo uploaded?
No. The photo stays on your phone.

packages.title: Package Tracker for USPS, UPS, FedEx and Amazon
packages.description: Every tracking number in one place: paste or scan a label, the carrier is detected for you, and you get a reminder the morning a package is due.
packages.h1: Every tracking number in one place
packages.intro: Packages in FavCircles keeps every tracking number in one place. Paste a tracking number or scan a shipping label and the carrier is detected for you (USPS, UPS, FedEx, Amazon, DHL, OnTrac). Open each carrier's tracking page in a tap, and get a reminder the morning a package is expected.
faq: Which carriers does it support?
USPS, UPS, FedEx, Amazon, DHL and OnTrac.
Can I scan a shipping label?
Yes, scan a label or paste the number.

newcontacts.title: See Recently Added Contacts on iPhone, Newest First
newcontacts.description: The last 50 people you added to your phone, newest first, so you can find the person you met last night without remembering their name.
newcontacts.h1: Find the person you met last night
newcontacts.intro: Recent Contacts shows the last 50 people you added to your iPhone, newest first, so you can find someone without remembering their name. Call, text or open their contact card in a tap. Nothing is uploaded; it stays on your phone.
faq: Can iPhone show contacts by date added?
The Contacts app doesn't sort by date added; Recent Contacts shows your last 50, newest first.
Are my contacts uploaded?
No. It stays on your phone.
